name: Browserbase
summary: Hosted headless Chrome infrastructure for agents and automation, controlled through Playwright, Puppeteer or its Stagehand SDK. It adds proxies, CAPTCHA solving, session recording, and extra APIs for search, fetch and serverless functions.
facts: $40M Series B led by Notable Capital (June 2025)
Free (1 browser-hour), Developer $20/mo, Startup $99/mo, Scale custom
US East, US West, EU Central, UK
goodFor: Running many browser sessions in parallel
watchOut: Stealth and CAPTCHA solving are not on the free plan
Usage billing adds up for long sessions
